Batch 18 is authored and locally ready. I reconciled the manifest and cross-batch edges with current suppliers, regenerated the proof contracts, and recorded all eight Step 1 decisions as `ready` at current hashes. The symmetry theorem’s dependency level is now **7**, matching the recomputed graph. Its mathematical suppliers remain draft, so the proofs use their stated interfaces conditionally.

Scoped checks passed: strict proof-contract validation, content policy, dependency checks, precheck (7 applicable items), proof layout (5 items, 12 steps), rendering (10 files), and the 3-source fetch check. All 16 cross-batch edges match the current manifest.

Two run-wide checks still report issues outside batch 18: contract coverage stops at the empty `emg-mm03` inventory, and dependency-level coverage reports 46 other empty page inventories. No batch 18 level mismatch remains. Details are in [author-check-18.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-author-check-18.json) and [batch-18 notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-18.notes.md).

The coverage records full-text reading of [Carroll](https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/9712019v1), [Tong](https://davidtong.org/pdfs/teaching/general-relativity/gr.pdf), and [Meinel–Hütten](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1105.3807), including their differing unit conventions and the paper’s restricted dust model. No independent proof approval or publication is claimed.
